name: saas_dark
archetype: Modern developer-focused SaaS product with dark mode interface
market: Global, B2B SaaS, software developers and engineering teams, $50-500/month price point
density: Clean and generous with whitespace, but information-rich in a structured way. Feature grids with icon+headline+description cards. Comparison tables. Testimonial carousels. Pricing tier cards side-by-side. Code snippet showcases. Integration logos grid.
nav_style: Dark sticky nav with logo on left, center nav links: Product, Features, Pricing, Docs, Blog. Right: GitHub stars badge, 'Sign in' ghost button, 'Start free' filled CTA button. On scroll: nav gains a subtle border-bottom glow.
commercial_model: Freemium SaaS. Three-tier pricing: Free, Pro, Team/Enterprise. Monthly/annual toggle with annual showing 20% discount. Enterprise has 'Contact sales' instead of price.
color_palette: Very dark grey (#0F1117) or near-black background. Electric blue (#4F6BFF) as primary accent. Light purple (#A78BFA) for secondary highlights. White (#FFFFFF) for primary text, light grey (#94A3B8) for secondary text. Green (#22C55E) for success states and 'active' badges. A true dark-mode-first design.
typography: Inter for UI text. Geist Mono or JetBrains Mono for code blocks. Headings in 48-64px for hero. Feature section headings at 32px. Body at 16px with generous line-height on dark backgrounds. Gradient text on hero headline using blue-to-purple gradient.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Dark hero with gradient text headline, subhead, two CTAs (Start Free + View Docs). Social proof: GitHub stars, companies using it logos strip. Feature overview grid 3 columns. Code snippet demo. Testimonial carousel. Pricing preview. Footer.

pages.title: Features
pages.description: Full features breakdown organized by category. Each feature has an illustration/diagram. Comparison with competitors in subtle table. Video demo embed placeholder. Integration section with 50+ partner logos.

pages.title: Pricing
pages.description: Monthly/Annual toggle. Three pricing cards: Free, Pro ($29/mo), Team ($99/mo). Feature comparison checklist per tier. Enterprise custom pricing CTA. FAQ accordion below. Usage-based pricing explanation.

pages.title: Documentation
pages.description: Docs landing page. Quick start guide with terminal commands. SDK installation tabs (npm, pip, cargo). API reference overview. Authentication guide. Webhooks guide. Community help link. Changelog.

pages.title: Blog & Changelog
pages.description: Engineering blog with technical articles. Changelog entries with version numbers and feature descriptions. Subscribe to updates email form. Categories: Engineering, Product, Company. Author profiles.
